text:
jess: Heads-up 1: want to run a focused co-marketing push with CloudPartner this quarter. Scope: marketplace listing + joint webinar + a short benchmark teardown blog + replay landing. aim: drive qualified demo requests and 3 pilot conversations. Threw a quick brief here: https://drive.redwood/partner-sprint-brief. Can team commit to a 3-week cadence?

ryan: timeline check 1: 3-week sounds tight but doable if we freeze assets and demo by EOD Wed next week. Recommend we do a 30m webinar (20 tech + 10 q&a) and a 5-min recorded demo to reduce risk.

kate: I'll own the marketplace listing and co-brand copy. need partner logos, short product blurb, 2 hero images (1200x628 + 600x400). also will need the technical bullet points for the listing by Tue.

denise: inbound routing plan 1: registrants -> HubSpot list "partner_marketplace" -> workflow: tag partner=CloudPartner, set lead_source=marketplace, then send to SDR queue if intent_score > 60 within 7 days. We should add utm params so we can separate ads vs organic. propose: utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cp_integration_q2

mario: benchmarks 1: eng-ml can provide a small table (latency median P95, tokens/sec, cost/token) but need the exact model + sequence length we test. propose: test gpt-small-1 at 512 tokens and a representative prompt set. can we lock prompts?

jess: i'll draft 6 short prompts for the benchmark by tomorrow AM. we'll anonymize and include methodology in the blog. keep it simple.

ryan: promo plan 1: owned email to our list (segment: infra + platform eng), paid partner audience (small spend), and social. timeline: launch announcement day 0, reminder day -3, day-of send. Kate, can you share CTAs?

kate: CTAs: "View benchmark & replay" + "Request a partner demo" + "Start trial on Redwood Hosted". We'll add a small checkbox on reg form: "Interested in pilot" to flag SDRs.

denise: form fields to include: name, company, email, role, checkbox pilot, hidden utm fields. Also set up a webhook to push to HubSpot as JSON so we can map custom intent flags.

mario: demo tech note 1: if we record, include a short sequence showing: 1) marketplace install 2) one-click model routing 3) metrics dashboard. We'll avoid real customer data.

jess: decisions: Recorded 5-min demo embedded in webinar + 20m live talk. Action owners: Kate - marketplace copy + images (due Fri), Mario - benchmark table + methodology (due Thu), Denise - HubSpot routing + UTMs (due Thu), Ryan - promo timeline and email copy (due Mon).

deploy-bot: Event created: "Webinar  CloudPartner + Redwood: Integrations that Speed Up Inference" Thu Jun 6 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.

kate: also need to confirm co-brand guidelines with partner ops. tagging @partner-ops to get final logo assets and approval. can partner marketing review by Wed?

jess: yes i'll ping partner-marketing. Also two subject line ideas for A/B: A) "See how CloudPartner + Redwood reduce inference cost" B) "Webinar: Faster inference with CloudPartner integration". pick whichever performs.

ryan: recommend we A/B the CTAs on the landing page as well. small test: CTA A = "View benchmark & replay" CTA B = "Book a partner demo". track conversions separately.

denise: noted. i'll add campaign tracking and create the HubSpot forms. Mario, once you drop the benchmark numbers i'll wire the benchmark CTA to the replay landing.

mario: will upload numbers + a CSV of raw test runs to the drive by Wed noon.

jess: perfect. final ask: design team  can you produce 3 social tiles (square + story + linkedin) and one 300x250 ad? need by Thu EOD so paid can launch. Thanks everyone.
